subject: Next steps: AP routing & payment options for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@spectral.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: AP routing & payment options for Redwood pilot

Thanks again for the call this morning, Samir — great to meet you and Lina. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has a single place to reference.

TL;DR: You said AP prefers PO for vendors onboarded via SOW/pilot, but card is possible for low-contract-value pilots if vendor setup is faster. Two paths we discussed: (A) traditional PO + vendor onboarding (typical enterprise route, ~2–4 weeks depending on internal approvals) or (B) card/marketplace for faster start (~3 business days) with slightly different invoicing.

Attachments I’m including: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (vendor metadata we need), and a draft SOW we can tailor. If you prefer, we can also route through the AWS Marketplace listing (we’re listed there) to speed payments — Ben included details below.

Can procurement confirm these three items by EOD Monday?
- AP preference: PO vs corporate card for this pilot
- Any required vendor forms beyond the checklist (e.g., W9, supplier questionnaire)
- Target invoice/payment terms (Net30/Net45)

Next steps from our side once you confirm:
- If PO: we’ll send a pro forma invoice + vendor profile packet for your AP team to start setup.
- If card/marketplace: share the card contact and we’ll provision billing and marketplace onboarding instructions.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

--
(Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, SOW-draft-Redwood-SpectralAI.docx)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@spectral.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@spectral.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@spectral.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: AP routing & payment options for Redwood pilot

Irene — thanks for the summary. Quick answers from our side so we can move forward: 

- AP preference: PO is preferred for any external vendor > $5k. This pilot will likely exceed that threshold.
- Required forms: procurement requested our vendor complete the Supplier Questionnaire (attached), plus a W9. I’ve attached the vendor form procurement wants filled.
- Terms: Net30 is standard for pilots but I will confirm with Lina if Procurement will accept Net45 in special cases.

We are comfortable with the PO route. Two follow-ups:
1) Can Redwood accept our standard PO number and invoice flow (PO -> invoice -> AP payment)?
2) If vendor setup takes >2 weeks, can we do a temporary card payment to get started while PO flows through? Procurement wants to know if Redwood supports a split onboarding path.

Adding Procurement to drive the onboarding timeline — Lina, any immediate concerns on your side?

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Data Platform | Spectral AI
samir.patel@spectral.ai
(Attachment: Vendor-Form_SpectralAI.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@spectral.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@spectral.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: AP routing & payment options for Redwood pilot

Hi Samir / Procurement team — looping in a couple notes from a commercial/ops angle so you have the concrete options and expected timelines.

Option A — Standard PO onboarding (recommended for >$5k pilots):
- Timeline: AP vendor setup typically 7–21 business days depending on legal/finance review.
- Deliverables from Redwood: vendor packet (completed checklist, W9, sample invoice), pro forma invoice tied to the pilot SOW.
- Billing: Invoice against submitted PO, Net30 (default) or Net45 if Procurement approves.

Option B — Temporary card/marketplace to start faster:
- Timeline: 1–5 business days to activate if payment via corporate card or through our AWS Marketplace listing.
- Constraints: Marketplace/third-party payments can complicate tax/invoice line items and may not be usable for certain departmental chargebacks.
- Recommendation: For pilots where time-to-value is critical, we accept card for the initial month and then reconcile the PO for the remaining term. This is a common split path.

Attachments I’m sharing: SOW-draft-Redwood-SpectralAI.docx and Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (complete these and we’ll kick vendor setup). Also, if you prefer DocuSign for the SOW, we can generate a Docusign link once the SOW is finalized.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Samir/Procurement: confirm PO number format and the contact at AP who will receive the vendor packet (name + email).
2) Redwood (Irene + Ben): prepare pro forma invoice and pre-filled vendor packet for your review — target delivery by Tue EOD.
3) If you want to start on card/marketplace while PO is pending, tell us which card holder to invoice and we’ll share the onboarding steps.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call with Lina to walkthrough forms if helpful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com | +1 (650) 555-0114

(Attachments: SOW-draft-Redwood-SpectralAI.docx, Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@spectral.ai>

Subject: Re: Next steps: AP routing & payment options for Redwood pilot

Thanks Ben — that lays it out nicely. Procurement confirms we will proceed with Option A (PO route).

Action items from Spectral AI:
- We will issue a PO (I’ll send the PO number once the internal approvers sign off). Expect that to be issued within 5–7 business days.
- I’ve attached the Vendor-Form_SpectralAI.pdf filled out — please confirm receipt.

Requests for Redwood:
1) Please provide a pro forma invoice and the completed vendor packet (checklist + W9) so our AP can start the record creation as soon as they receive it.
2) If vendor setup extends beyond 10 business days, we may request a temporary card payment to avoid blocking the pilot start — we’ll coordinate that with you if it becomes necessary.

Irene / Ben — sending you both the PO owner contact at procurement: Lina Gomez (lina.gomez@spectral.ai). Lina, feel free to reach out directly to Ben or Irene for any missing items.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Samir
Head of Data Platform | Spectral AI
